gcaiBaseUrl.title: GreenChemistry.ai destination
gcaiBaseUrl.description: Destination for the reviewed manual handoff.

enableSuppliesOrders.title: Allow pending Supplies orders
enableSuppliesOrders.description: Keep off initially. When enabled, a scientist must select a catalog item and explicitly confirm a persisted PENDING order. This does not enable automatic purchasing.

gcaiBridge.title: GCai connection (live-tested in staging)
gcaiBridge.description: Stay disabled by default. When enabled, a signed-in GreenChemistry.ai user is required and reviewed source content is retained server-side for up to 90 days. The popup posts decisions back to this add-on; the add-on acknowledges receipt before the connection is treated as complete.

enabled.title: Enable connection to GCai receiver
enabled.description: Opens the secure popup. Leave off to use the reviewed clipboard handoff instead. Once enabled, every reviewed source submitted through this add-on triggers a GCai connection.

deadlineMs.title: Connection timeout (milliseconds)
deadlineMs.description: How long the add-on keeps the connection open and waits for a reviewed result to come back. 15 min covers analysis plus human review; 1 hour is the hard cap.
